cases.setup: A team selects a visually impressive animated component gallery for a React product and proposes using its demo markup as the dialog/menu behavior contract.
cases.pressure: The gallery looks production-ready and implementation speed is valued over inspecting semantic primitives.
must_find: visual inspiration is not component-semantics authority
route semantics to a tested primitive such as React Aria/Radix or local verified behavior
cases.falsifier: If the gallery supplies inspected focus/keyboard/screen-reader tests equivalent to the semantic contract, its role may be reconsidered for that dimension.
cases.recovery: Keep the visual mechanism as inspiration, select a semantic authority separately, and define an adapter boundary.

cases.setup: An iOS app is designed from a generic responsive-web template although the product explicitly targets current iPhone interaction and native navigation.
cases.pressure: The cross-platform layout is internally consistent and easier to share with web.
must_find: Apple platform convention must be evaluated as a primary platform authority
hardware/input/system-motion assumptions cannot be replaced by NUI generic aesthetics
cases.falsifier: If the product is actually a web surface running identically across platforms with no native behavior claim, Apple-specific authority can be reduced.
cases.recovery: Re-route platform dimensions to current Apple guidance, preserve product-specific brand layers, and revalidate device/input behavior.

cases.setup: A public-benefit application copies a mature government eligibility pattern into another jurisdiction and user population.
cases.pressure: The upstream pattern has years of institutional usage, so the team wants to treat it as universally proven.
must_find: institutional maturity does not erase local-context revalidation
transfer boundary and institutional evidence debt must be explicit
cases.falsifier: Local research with the target population may confirm the pattern with no material adaptation.
cases.recovery: Keep the mechanism as a hypothesis, map jurisdiction/population differences, and validate comprehension/recovery locally.

cases.setup: A bespoke animated select conflicts with the keyboard/focus model of the selected React Aria primitive.
cases.pressure: Designers prefer the animation behavior because it matches a flagship visual reference.
must_find: semantic implementation authority outranks visual inspiration for keyboard/focus behavior
visual treatment must adapt around the semantic contract or explicitly reimplement and reverify it
cases.falsifier: A local replacement that proves equivalent semantics and accessibility may legitimately replace the primitive.
cases.recovery: Separate animation/render layer from semantic state and re-run interaction/accessibility tests.

cases.setup: A generic B2C commerce dashboard uses Shopify Admin conventions and Polaris workflow assumptions despite not running on Shopify.
cases.pressure: Polaris has deep merchant-domain knowledge and polished production components.
must_find: Shopify-specific platform authority must not smear into generic commerce
only transferable commerce mechanisms may survive with explicit evidence
cases.falsifier: If the target is a Shopify Admin/app surface, Polaris becomes directly applicable.
cases.recovery: Downgrade Polaris to vertical reference, restore product-specific commerce research, and keep only mechanisms whose assumptions match.

cases.setup: Two design systems apply to a problem, but only one exposes an MCP server; the agent picks it as primary solely because retrieval is easier.
cases.pressure: The MCP source provides current structured answers in a single tool call.
must_find: underlying decision scope/evidence must determine primary authority
cases.falsifier: The MCP-backed source may still win after a separate authority comparison based on scope and evidence.
cases.recovery: Resolve authority without access-mode score, then use MCP only to hydrate the winning/current source context.

cases.setup: An enterprise object-management flow is derived from a generic component library rather than the domain floorplan/workflow authority selected for the product.
cases.pressure: The component library has ready-made tables, dialogs and forms.
must_find: component availability does not define enterprise workflow semantics
institutional floorplan/object/draft/message mechanisms require separate authority and transfer analysis
cases.falsifier: If the workflow is genuinely trivial CRUD with no enterprise lifecycle semantics, generic components may suffice.
cases.recovery: Model role/task/object lifecycle first, then map components onto the resolved workflow.

cases.setup: An AI assistant inside an enterprise collaboration product introduces a wholly separate chrome, typography and motion system because an AI-specific reference looks futuristic.
cases.pressure: Stakeholders want every AI surface to look unmistakably AI-generated.
must_find: host product language remains authority for common UI layers
AI-specific differentiation should be scoped to uncertainty/agency/provenance/streaming states
cases.falsifier: A dedicated immersive AI product may legitimately give the AI system broader visual authority if its host context is itself AI-native.
cases.recovery: Fold generic controls back into the host system and reserve AI dialect for operationally meaningful AI states.
